channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLhealthAndWellness, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Health apps found biased before coding begins
item.description: Digital health tools like period trackers, fitness apps, and mental health quizzes are widely used, but many contain inherent biases.

item.title: Nordic diet may extend life, liver effects uncertain
item.description: A healthy diet generally lowers the risk of major diseases. The Nordic diet's specific impact on the liver remains unclear.

item.title: Childhood circumstances linked to lifespan
item.description: People with lower incomes tend to live shorter lives, a pattern seen even in wealthy nations with strong welfare systems, such as Norway.

item.title: Lab results over patient judgment is a new medical error
item.description: A podcast episode discusses how relying on lab results over patient symptoms can lead to medical errors.
